title: Supervision and Regulation — 2024 Annual Report
summary: This is a chapter from the Federal Reserve's 2024 Annual Report covering supervision and regulation functions, presenting institutional statistics on the banking sector as of year-end 2024, including the breakdown of supervised entities by asset size (community banking organizations, regional banking organizations, large banking organizations, and LISCC institutions). The source also covers financial market utilities (FMUs) supervised by the Fed.
key_points: As of December 31, 2024, 3,408 community banking organizations (CBOs) held $3.0 trillion in total assets
105 regional banking organizations (RBOs) with total assets between $10B and $100B held $3.0 trillion
Eight U.S. global systemically important banks (G-SIBs) in the LISCC portfolio held $15.2 trillion in total assets
172 large and foreign banking organizations (LFBOs) held $10.4 trillion in total combined assets
As of year-end 2025, 497 domestic bank holding companies and 46 foreign banking organizations held financial holding company (FHC) status
The Fed supervised five companies significantly engaged in insurance activities with approximately $450 billion in total assets as of December 31, 2024
Financial market utilities (FMUs) manage multilateral systems for transferring, clearing, or settling payments and securities transactions among financial institutions
